# asicode silent-except baseline — KNOWN pre-existing handlers whose
# body purely swallows the exception (pass/return None/return/continue/
# break) with no raise and no log call — plus broad `suppress()` calls
# (suppress(Exception/BaseException) or empty suppress()) and broad
# handlers whose body is only `return <empty>` (emptyret:: keys: []/{} /
# ()/set()/''/0/False).  Narrow suppress(KeyError) and narrow except +
# empty return are NOT baselined (never flagged).
#
# Generated by `scripts/check_no_new_silent_except.py --write-baseline`.
# Hand-editing is allowed: sorted, one key per line, `#` comments ok.
# Key: <rel_path>::<scope_qualname>::<ordinal>  (stable under line drift)
# emptyret keys: emptyret::<rel_path>::<scope_qualname>::<ordinal>
# suppress keys: suppress::<rel_path>::<scope_qualname>::<ordinal>
# NOTE: the ordinal is the handler's index among ALL except handlers in
# the scope (silent or not), so REMOVING any handler shifts later keys.
# After a legit removal round (e.g. try/except/pass → suppress), re-run
# `--write-baseline` — index-shifted keys are false "new" hits.
#
# ── Intentional keep-sites (F2 audit, 2026): each is a documented external
# boundary where a silent empty result IS the contract — not an oversight.
#
# tree_sitter_utils.query_captures/query_matches: leaf tree-sitter C-API
# execution boundary. Query execution on pathological trees has unbounded
# failure modes (C API errors); returning [] is the documented "no captures"
# result and callers treat it as such. No outer fence exists (unlike
# symbol_search's extractors), so this IS the boundary.
emptyret::external_llm/languages/tree_sitter_utils.py::<module>::query_captures::0
emptyret::external_llm/languages/tree_sitter_utils.py::<module>::query_matches::0
#
# asi._maybe_show_update_notice: fail-open startup daemon — "update check must
# never break the CLI". Runs on a daemon thread; swallowing keeps a broken
# version-check (import, network, cache) from impairing the interactive CLI.
suppress::asi.py::<module>::_maybe_show_update_notice::0
#
# symbol_search._extract_all_python_symbols::0/::1: TS→AST fallback boundary
# (the outer fences whose inner extractors were deduplicated in F2). Any
# tree-sitter parse failure on arbitrary source degrades to the identical AST
# path — the fence pair is the whole-file degrade contract.
# symbol_search._ts_module_map: TSSemanticTracer enrichment — "never block
# execution" for the optional semantic-index path (lazy import + analysis).
suppress::external_llm/agent/symbol_search.py::<module>::SymbolSearcher::_extract_all_python_symbols::0
suppress::external_llm/agent/symbol_search.py::<module>::SymbolSearcher::_extract_all_python_symbols::1
suppress::external_llm/agent/symbol_search.py::<module>::SymbolSearcher::_ts_module_map::0
